messages:
kevin: Packaging finished. uploaded airgap bundle to s3://releases/private/2026-03-18/rc2. Manifest: installer-manifest-v20260318-rc2.json
kevin: SHA256: ba5e7c3f9d2a4f1c8e0b3a1f6d9e4a2b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0 and md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
kevin: Need cosign signing + KMS key rotation check before handoff. Can we pin image digests instead of tags?

deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded. size 1.9GB. Signed=false. Actions: generate-manifest -> done. verify-checksums -> pending

maria: I'll run cosign sign using project-kms-key-4. Confirm signer identity: tony? If KMS rotated yesterday we need new key id.

tony: yep key rotated. new key id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/release-2026-03. I'll sign after you confirm checksum algorithm (we prefer sha256)

samir: prefer digest pinning in manifest: use image@sha256:<digest> and installer tar.gz@sha256:<digest>. Do not rely on md5.

jessica: customer A wants canary only in their VPC tonight 23:00-01:00 PST. If canary blocked, we'll fallback to full rollout next window. Thoughts on skipping global canary?

maria: Given the size and limited windows, propose: do per-customer VPC canary only, skip broad staging canary. Ops OK with that?

opsbot: ALERT: change window overlaps with infra maintenance in us-west-2 at 00:30. Recommend holding global rollout until 04:00.

kevin: OK final plan: 1) Pin all artifacts to sha256 in manifest. 2) Maria to cosign with new KMS key. 3) Publish manifest + cosign verification blob to s3 and k8s release channel. 4) Run per-customer VPC canary for Customer A 23:00 PST. If install healthcheck fails >15m -> roll back to manifest v20260317 (digest: sha256:abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890)

maria: starting cosign sign now. command:
```
cosign sign-blob --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/release-2026-03 installer-manifest-v20260318-rc2.json
```

deploy-bot: cosign signature uploaded. verification ok.

tony: added image digests to manifest and updated release_notes.md: "RC2: airgap packaging, cosign+KMS sign, per-customer canary". Pushed to s3.

kevin: I'll update release tracker and send note to customer success to expect canary tonight. tagging @jessica

jessica: ack, I'll inform CS and include rollback criteria and post-install sanity checks.

samir: one nit: include a one-line script in the manifest bucket to verify locally:
```
sha256sum -c installer-sha256sums.txt
cosign verify-blob --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/release-2026-03 -signature installer-manifest-v20260318-rc2.json.sig installer-manifest-v20260318-rc2.json
```

kevin: perfect. locking manifest now. moving to done. :lock:
